Messages.Author: adam....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Three players (A prey of B who is prey of C)

Player C has a vampire with Spiritus who is tapped.

Player B's vampire does a (D) action on player A (eg bleed)

Player C attempts to play Speak with Spirits and then Falcon's Eye.
Illegal? Because Speak with Spirits says that you must attempt to
block when being played. And you cannot because it is a (D) action.
Falcon's Eye never has a chance to be played. (one would need an
additional wake to be played first.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
adam....@gmail.com wrote:
> Three players (A prey of B who is prey of C)

The normal ordering is ABC clockwise: A is the predator of B and so on.
But, given the counterclockwise ordering...

> Player C has a vampire with Spiritus who is tapped.
>
> Player B's vampire does a (D) action on player A (eg bleed)
>
> Player C attempts to play Speak with Spirits and then Falcon's Eye.
> Illegal? Because Speak with Spirits says that you must attempt to
> block when being played. And you cannot because it is a (D) action.

Correct. Illegal for a vampire who cannot attempt to block to play Speak with
Spirits.

> Falcon's Eye never has a chance to be played. (one would need an
> additional wake to be played first.)

Correct.
